Messages.Author: Dasein
Messages.Body:
I have a couple of questions regarding NRA PAC.
Assuming the NRA PAC is on the table...
if I get some equipment with Jack of Both Sides, do I untap at the end
of the turn?
If I play Magic of the Smith and get, say, a Heart of Nizchetus, do I
untap at the end of the turn?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Yes, any successful equip action will trigger NRA PAC's untap.

Messages.Author: floppyzedolfin
Messages.Body:
Yes, since they are both "equip action"'s. Works even for Vast Wealth,
Filchware's Pawn Shop, and so on.
But a vampire would not untap via NRA PAC if he gets his equipment
from a Disguised Weapon (for instance), since it is not an "equip
action".
